vin.description: The 17-character VIN exactly as printed on the page. Null if no VIN appears anywhere in the text. Never construct, guess, or infer a VIN from partial characters.

model.description: Vehicle model, e.g. Insight, Corolla Hybrid, Camry Hybrid, Prius.

trim.description: Trim level if stated, else null.

price.description: Asking price in US dollars as a plain number, no currency symbol or thousands separators. Null if no price is stated.

mileage.description: Odometer mileage in miles as a plain integer. Null if no mileage is stated.

dealerName.description: The selling dealer's name exactly as printed on the page (e.g. 'Holler Honda'). Null if no dealer name is stated, such as a private-party listing.

dealerLocation.description: The selling dealer's city and state as printed on the page, e.g. 'Winter Park, FL'. Null if no dealer location is stated.
